# Mode: review and fix

Use only when fixes are requested.

1. Review with [changes](mode-changes.md) or [project](mode-project.md) mode first and share the findings.
2. Confirm the fix scope when a finding needs a product or API decision.
3. For each fix, choose Redesign, Align, Enhance, or Drop, and fix the root cause test-first. Fix the same pattern across the scope.
4. Rerun the affected gates and the lens checks for the fixed findings.
5. Leave edits uncommitted. Commit, amend, push, or PR only with separate authorization.
